notes.title: Update 1.1 | Steam Deck support & Timelines Tracker
notes.content:
Happy New Year 2025 to you and Happy 1 year Anniversary to Time Glitch!

It's been exactly one year since we released Time Glitch on Steam, and we wanted to celebrate that by pushing an update for the game.

This update brings two major additions: 
- controller support
- a helpful new screen to find all story branches
As well as a bunch of smaller quality-of-life enhancements.

Check out the full changelog below!

Changelog of the 1.1 update:

 The game is now fully playable with a controller and on Steam Deck!
 We added a new Hints screen in the menu, with the one and only Time Lich helping you figure out how to reach those timelines you may have missed. This should be helpful to get that eluding 100% completion achievement
 The way the game counts timelines changed slightly to account for quasi-duplicates. You might get the 100% completion achievement immediately if you've played the game before
 Dice information is now displayed in its own panel, above the story text
 Added a confirmation screen when pressing the Quit button
 Some helpful instructions appear the first time you have to roll the dice
 Speech bubbles are now in the same colour as the character speaking/thinking/screaming
 Text in Tabletop mode is slightly bigger and more readable
 Dice in Tabletop mode get bigger when hovered and grabbed
 Removed text 1+ from Initiative roll
 Line spacing was decreased for Accessible font


Also huge Thanks to @LeeneOfficial (from Placeholder Gameworks) for making us really cool Time Glitch themed dice!

notes.title: Recommence | Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
We are excited to release the first update after our release a few weeks ago. which includes quality-of-life enhancements and localized fixes. Check out the full changelog below!

Changelog of the 1.0.1 update:

 Added an option to continue playing from where you left off your previous session (endings and dice information are saved)
 Added a message to teach the "long skip" feature; it will be displayed after a few loops.
 Some visual issues with the Polish localizations have been fixed.

notes.title: Time Glitch, out now!
notes.content:
Step into the realm of Time Glitch, where every roll of the dice twists fate and time! Launching today, this unique experience awaits you. As you face the undead king at the end of a campaign, you'll discover that every defeat is just a new beginning.

Here's what's in store in Time Glitch:

 Strategic Dice Rolls: Harness the power of precognition. Remember your dice outcomes to make game-changing decisions. Each roll is a step towards victory or a return to the dungeon's gates.
 Bite-Sized Tabletop RPG: As you find your party at the end of a campaign, the game will take around 20 minutes to play or an hour to explore all endings.
 4th Wall Breaking Fun: Enjoy a quirky, meta-adventure within a game, packed with drama and unexpected turns.
 Friendship and Fate: Every choice shapes the world and the bonds between your characters. Forge your path to victory or risk the ties that keep your party together.



Are you ready to break the cycle, defeat the undead king, and claim a glorious end to your campaign?

Grab your dice and let the adventure begin!
